framework.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AIMS) & ISO/IEC 23894:2023 (AI Risk Management)
framework.description: International standards for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (ISO/IEC 42001) and AI Risk Management (ISO/IEC 23894).

controls.title: AI Policy and Governance Controls (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.2)
controls.description: Establish and maintain organizational policies governing acceptable AI use, security testing authorization, and operational risk boundaries.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.2 — Policies Related to AI

controls.title: Assessing AI System Impacts (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.5)
controls.description: Assess and document potential consequences of AI system failures, unauthorized disclosures, or autonomous agent actions on individuals, tenants, and organizations.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.5 — Assessing Impacts of AI Systems

controls.title: AI System Design and Architectural Specification (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.6)
controls.description: Specify and implement secure architectural boundaries for prompt handling, retrieval access controls, output sanitization, and tool parameter schemas.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.6 — AI System Life Cycle

controls.title: AI System Verification and Validation (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.6)
controls.description: Define and execute verification and validation measures—including adversarial security testing and deterministic canary evaluation—against specified security requirements.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.6 — AI System Life Cycle

controls.title: AI System Deployment and Resource Limits (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.6)
controls.description: Ensure deployment configurations enforce resource consumption ceilings, sampling parameter bounds, and environment secret isolation prior to production release.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.6 — AI System Life Cycle

controls.title: Quality and Security of Data for AI Systems (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.7)
controls.description: Verify that data ingested into RAG vector stores and model contexts meets integrity, sanitization, and tenant classification requirements.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.7 — Data for AI Systems

controls.title: System Documentation and Output Transparency (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.8)
controls.description: Provide clear technical documentation and ensure downstream consumers safely handle and validate AI-generated outputs.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.8 — Information for Interested Parties

controls.title: Human Oversight of AI Systems (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.9)
controls.description: Enforce effective human oversight and approval mechanisms over autonomous AI agent decisions and privileged tool invocations.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.9 — Use of AI Systems

controls.title: Allocating Responsibilities Across Tenants and Third Parties (ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.10)
controls.description: Enforce strict multi-tenant data isolation and access boundaries between customers, tenants, and external tool providers.
controls.category: ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A.10 — Third-Party and Customer Relationships

controls.title: AI Risk Identification (ISO/IEC 23894 Clause 6.3)
controls.description: Systematic identification of AI-specific risk sources, including prompt injection, context poisoning, model configuration drift, and excessive agency.

controls.title: AI Risk Analysis and Evaluation (ISO/IEC 23894 Clause 6.4)
controls.description: Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of AI vulnerability severity, exploitability, blast radius, and detection confidence.

controls.title: AI Risk Treatment and Control Verification (ISO/IEC 23894 Clause 6.5)
controls.description: Selection, implementation, and post-remediation verification of preventive and detective security controls for AI systems.
